name: @course-factory/workspace
description: P6 shared workspace: main-owned coordination vocabulary, digest-bound reviewed access policy, the P6.4 confined Windows host file adapter (read plus staged atomic publication), the P6.6 trusted editor admission with main-owned document registry (identifier-only, no execution, no persistence bytes, no presentation), the P6.7 admitted document open/create execution (exact load and staged creation, no pre-save disk mutation), the P6.8 deterministic type planner/scheduler (admitted type_code plans and schedules only, no buffer or disk mutation, no presentation), the P6.9 deterministic exact replacement planner (admitted replace_code match guards and transactional visual plans only, no buffer or disk mutation, no presentation) and the P6.10 admitted document save with bounded canonical journal (commit boundary, byte verify, exactly-one outcome) for one lesson workspace shared by the P5 terminal engine and the P6 typing engine. No container, presentation, or UI behavior.
